Generate recent-arrival CD4 counts

Source: R/sim_diags_fns.R
generate_recent_arrival_cd4.Rd

Generates annual age-group by CD4 counts among diagnoses of infections present on arrival, restricted to arrival in the diagnosis year or the preceding calendar year.

Usage

generate_recent_arrival_cd4(m_age, d_probs_mig, q_age, completeness, dist)

Arguments

m_age

Undiagnosed migrant arrivals by age, quarter, and the four non-recent CD4 states.

d_probs_mig

Migrant diagnosis probabilities by quarter, age, and the four non-AIDS CD4 states.

q_age

Progression probabilities by age and state.

completeness

Proportion of eligible diagnoses observed.

dist

Logical indicating whether to add stochastic variation.

Value

A list containing observed and expected annual count arrays.
